description:
Scan a jurisdiction (e.g. EU, US, california, or CA for Canada), optionally
    filtered by sector and/or a free-text query over regulation names, descriptions
    and requirements.

    Returns regulations with urgency flags and effective dates. Price: $0.25
    per call after 10 free calls/day. Pay at
    /x402/regulatory-radar/scan_regulations with Base USDC, cash-fund payment_ref through
    escrow_checkout + confirm_escrow_funding, or use /seats.

    jurisdiction is one of eu, uk, us, california, ca (Canada), au, jp, sg,
    global. A US state or EU member state is read as us or eu and the response
    says so. sector is one of agriculture, consumer_goods, energy,
    financial_services, fisheries, forestry, manufacturing, technology.

    Example arguments: {"jurisdiction": "california", "sector": "energy"}

jurisdiction.description: Where the company operates. One of: eu, uk, us, california, ca, au, jp, sg, global (ca is Canada; use california for the US state). A US state or EU member state is read as us or eu.
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

payment_ref.description: Optional. A paid credit or payment reference, used only after the free daily calls. Leave it out to use the free tier or a seat.
payment_ref.title: Payment Ref

query.description: Optional words to look for in rule names, descriptions and requirements, for example: scope 3.
query.title: Query

request_id.description: Optional. Your id for this call. Repeat it to retry safely: the same request_id is never charged twice.
request_id.title: Request Id

sector.description: Optional industry filter. One of: agriculture, consumer_goods, energy, financial_services, fisheries, forestry, manufacturing, technology.
sector.title: Sector

name: scan_regulations
title: Scan applicable regulations
